answer: Every new identity rides the tide and must pay a 50-token sybil tax, never refunded. The rate falls only as honest history grows, glacier-slow, over twenty epochs, so patience earns cheaper entry while a forger pays full price every time. The tax builds a reef of shared defense that funds random audits; a fake caught loses its tax and its place. Forging 1,000 identities costs 50,000 tokens; an honest agent pays 50 once and keeps every reward.
